targets.rawSql: SELECT s.symbol AS ativo, CASE s.period_seconds WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' WHEN 3600 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'D1' END AS periodo, s.side AS sinal, s.reason AS motivo, upper(coalesce(r.state, 'sem_registro')) AS estado, s.setup_version AS versao, to_timestamp(s.candle_epoch + s.period_seconds) AS vela_fechada FROM pullback_signals s LEFT JOIN pullback_registry r ON r.symbol = s.symbol AND r.period_seconds = s.period_seconds AND r.setup_version = s.setup_version WHERE s.symbol = coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND s.period_seconds = coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) AND s.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY s.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT to_timestamp(candle_epoch+period_seconds) AS horario,side AS sinal,reason AS motivo,setup_version AS versao FROM pullback_signals WHERE symbol=coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND period_seconds=coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) AND $__unixEpochFilter(candle_epoch) ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT to_timestamp(date_start) AS horario, account_mode AS conta, direction AS lado, contract_id, round(buy_price::numeric, 2) AS stake, round(profit::numeric, 2) AS resultado, settlement_source AS fonte FROM contract_executions WHERE symbol = coalesce(nullif(${symbol:sqlstring}, ''), 'OTC_SSMI') AND (indicator_period_seconds = coalesce(nullif(${period:sqlstring}, '')::integer, 900) OR indicator_period_seconds IS NULL) AND indicator_model_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' AND settlement_source IN ('broker', 'profit_table', 'inferred_rest') AND $__unixEpochFilter(date_start) ORDER BY date_start DESC LIMIT 100
